Don't have a PIN Change Number or One Time Password?

You'll need to complete a PIN change request for your card through Heritage Internet Banking. Your PIN Change Number will be displayed in Internet Banking, and your One Time Password will be sent to you via email or SMS (whichever you choose).

Need more help?

If you need more help or have any questions relating to changing your PIN or Internet Banking please phone our specialist team on 1300 722 767. For any other enquiries please phone our Contact Centre on 13 14 22. We’re available over the phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
